answer: Total energy consumption was 85 MMWh in both 2025 and restated 2024; fossil energy was 47 and 49 MMWh, representing 55% and 58%; renewable energy was 13 and 12 MMWh, representing 16% and 14%. The narrative nevertheless reports a 0.4% increase, reflecting unrounded data. Renewable electricity instruments were PPAs, VPPAs, and RECs or guarantees of origin.

evidence.quote: In 2025, our total energy consumption was 85 million megawatt hours (M MWh), a 0.4% increase compared to 2024.
